resulting_behavior: The v1.2 variable identity schema and package functions preserve literal wire names, labels, concepts, definitions, source and observed type assertions, units/applicability, literal code values, missingness, explicit mapping states and capture pointers. CDC/Census/CMS versioned adapters are replayable from capture hashes and JSON pointers. Existing cdc_columns/census_variables transformations and frozen machine contracts remain unchanged. Publication and promotion remain false; unresolved context and HCRIS discrepancies cannot mint or select a resolved identity. Resolved replay now requires an independently supplied exact context and capture-backed evidence; failed or byte-less captures cannot verify. Variable contexts require source/asset relationship facts or accepted PR-007 binding evidence when released core snapshots omit those parent fields, while the frozen endpoint shape remains unchanged. Measurement units in unknown or omitted states keep completeness unknown. Registered immutable snapshot source and asset parent facts remain consistency constraints even when independent relationship evidence is supplied, so foreign caller parents cannot override the registered snapshot. The existing machine-toolkit v1.2 variable schema now has a private package descriptor, local README, strict offline Ajv2020 validator and independent positive/negative tests. The workspace lock adds only that descriptor and its node_modules link; no route, release, publication or scientific authority is added. September 12 reviewed correction: CMS parser-only names remain documented names. Exact/reviewed-alias CMS wire mappings require an explicit wire_name and an explicit mapping with evidence; unsupported cases retain unmatched mappings and null wire names. Evidence-bearing exact/alias controls and CDC/Census native keys remain supported; unresolved context carries null IDs and disabled publication/promotion.
